descriptions.zh: 我们已经完全解密了这艘坠毁殖民船中的文档，现在，我们已能够精准确定我们的母星在星系中的位置。
descriptions.en: Now that the files in the crashed slaver ship are fully decrypted, we will be able to pinpoint the galactic position of our home worlds.

descriptions.zh: 我们的社会存在着严重的割裂。将许多星球和许多不同的文化统合在一起，免不了会滋生矛盾。希望本委员会能够为这个问题提供解决方案。
descriptions.en: Our society is deeply divided. A union of many worlds, and many different cultures, does not come without tension. It is to be hoped that this committee can offer solutions to the problem.

descriptions.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的MSI战舰的路线。
descriptions.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch spaceships from [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Under the proposed cleanup project, specially-designed construction ships will utilize nets to dredge the space in near-orbit, allowing us to approach the MSI warship that still looms over our capital.

descriptions.zh:
这艘战舰将成为我们舰队的瑰宝。

这艘战舰将得到修复，变成一艘功能齐全的§H旗舰§!，能够作为一个移动船坞使用。
descriptions.en:
The warship will become the gem of our fleet.

The warship shall be repaired and turned into a functioning §HFlagship§!.

descriptions.zh:
这艘战舰经过改造之后，现在将用于科学研究。

经过修复之后，这台曾经的死亡机器现在被转变成一个功能齐全的§H居住站§!，致力于揭开弥特集团科技的秘密。
descriptions.en:
The warship will now be retrofitted for scientific research.

Following repairs, this former instrument of death will be fully converted into a functioning §HHabitat§!, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology.

descriptions.zh: 技术的最新进展使得我们能够改装旗舰，用上一些以前未使用过的系统。
descriptions.en: Recent advances in our technology will allow us to refit our flagship to make use of some previously unused systems.

descriptions.zh: 击中大分裂者的那颗小行星异常地富含钨元素，许多科学家声称他们已经“证实”这是一起对我们恒星系的攻击。遗憾的是，我们与之的协议意味着我们必须迎合这些胡思乱想。
descriptions.en: The asteroid that hit the Divider contained an abnormal amount of tungsten, and several scientists now claim to have "proof" that this was an attack on our solar system. Sadly, our agreements with their world mean we will have to humor these fancies.

descriptions.zh: 假使有足够时间的话，单一艘科研船就可以构建一个涨落力场来改变钨导弹的矢量。但光是这个可能还不够。
descriptions.en: A lone science ship could, given enough time, establish a fluctuating force field to change the vector of the tungsten missile. But that in itself may not be enough.

descriptions.zh: 特别改造的鱼雷可以通过编程将自身附着在这些炮弹上，通过反向推进器把这份“惊喜”的速度降下来。
descriptions.en: Specially modified torpedoes could be programmed to attach themselves to the projectile; by reversing their thrust, they might just slow this 'gift' down.

descriptions.zh: 尽管在我们的恒星系里没有什么比这个钨质小行星的密度更大，但太空石块还是有不少的。即使只能以亚光速发射，但用另一颗小行星砸上去应该能缓解这场危机。
descriptions.en: While we don't have anything as dense as a tungsten asteroid in our system, we have no shortage of space rocks. Even at less than lightspeed, firing a counter asteroid at the current threat might help.

descriptions.zh: 把这颗钨质炮弹直接炸毁好像是个不错的主意，但产生的碎片仍然会对我们的行星造成毁灭性打击。我们的科学家已经计算出了一个受控破拆流程，也许可以将这颗炮弹拆分成更好处理的形式。
descriptions.en: Blowing up the tungsten bullet might seem appealing, but the resulting shrapnel would still have a catastrophic impact on our world. Our scientists have calculated a controlled detonation sequence that might help fracture the projectile into a slightly more manageable form.

descriptions.zh: §H万爪之母§!在我们首都的凭空出现证明了“灵能传送”这一曾经只存在于理论层面的概念是实操上可行的。通过让我们最能干的[owner.GetScientistPlural]投入研究工作，也许就可以学会这种瞬间旅行方式的秘密。
descriptions.en: The sudden appearance of the §HMany-Tentacled One§! on our capital has proven that the once theoretical concept of 'psionic teleportation' is workable in practice. By putting our most effective [owner.GetScientistPlural] on the job, it might be possible for us to learn the secrets of instantaneous interstellar travel.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]应该可以完成伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围§Y[This.GetName]§!的护盾，只需要提供足够的资源就行。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetResearchers] should be able to complete the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over §Y[This.GetName]§!, if we can provide them with sufficient resources.

descriptions.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName]担心穴居人可能会发动一场入侵。这样的担忧是毫无根据的，但是提供额外的部队能够帮助我们赢取他们的信任。
descriptions.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName] are worried about a possible subterranean invasion. It's a baseless fear, but providing additional troops will help us gain their trust.
